scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with exact determinant calculation and finite numerical corroboration; previous ellipsoid cases not claimed as new. No independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Only d>=3, finitely many nondegenerate global diameter pairs with strictly positive endpoint curvature; no degenerate/continuum case or uniform error rate. Prior full text for Gates (1987) and Ren (2014) was unavailable; priority risk remains.
title: Curvature-determinant endpoint law for invariant random chords in smooth convex bodies
